players.product: multi-beam and single-beam electron-beam mask writers and spot-beam electron-beam lithography systems (Industrial Equipment); TEM / FIB systems for semiconductor inspection

quarterly_data.signal: Product launch: HAXIS low-angle ion-milling scanning electron microscope (LIM-SEM Multi Beam System), JEOL's new semiconductor failure-analysis platform that combines argon-ion Low-Angle Ion Milling delayering with SEM imaging and passive voltage contrast (PVC) observation to locate defects in advanced semiconductor devices without nano-manipulator probing; sales commence October 5, 2026, with a sales target of 15 units/year.
quarterly_data.figure: sales from October 5, 2026; sales target 15 units/year
